story.text: My Health Concerns. These are the health issues that are most on your mind right now. Sharing your concerns helps your care team focus on what matters most to you.

story.label: Health Concerns Checklist
options: I'm having trouble managing my medications
I'm having trouble getting to my appointments
I'm having trouble affording my medications
value: I'm having trouble managing my medications
I'm having trouble getting to my appointments
story.comments: The metformin makes me feel sick so I skip it sometimes.

story.text: My Health Goals. These are the goals you and your care team have agreed to work toward. Goals should be specific, realistic, and meaningful to you.

story.goal: Check blood sugar every morning and record it
story.notes: Will use the log book from the pharmacy.

story.goal: Reduce salt intake to help lower blood pressure
story.notes: Switched to low-sodium soups and stopped adding salt at the table.

story.text: Action Steps. These are the specific tasks you and your care team have agreed on to help reach your goals.

story.action: Call the diabetes education center to schedule a class
Ask Dr. Washerman about nausea from Metformin at next visit
story.notes: Doctor suggested taking it with food. Trying that now.
